private-house-construction.title: Private house construction
private-house-construction.description: Construction of a private house for a comfortable, practical living environment.
private-house-construction.longDescription: This project presents an approach to private house construction focused on effective space planning, the sequence of works and quality. Everyday comfort and a harmonious connection between the house and its surroundings are central to the approach.

land-survey.title: Land survey
land-survey.description: A land survey to establish a clear understanding of the site.
land-survey.longDescription: A land survey is an important preparatory stage in design and construction. It helps establish the boundaries, shape and characteristics of the site and provides baseline information for planning subsequent work.

modern-kitchen.title: Modern kitchen
modern-kitchen.description: A modern kitchen with understated design and a considered layout.
modern-kitchen.longDescription: Everyday usability is at the heart of the kitchen design. Work surfaces, storage areas and furniture layout are considered together to create a cohesive, harmonious space.

residential-house-design.title: Residential house design
residential-house-design.description: A residential house design with functional, harmonious spaces.
residential-house-design.longDescription: In residential house design, the architectural appearance and interior layout complement one another. The approach prioritises room connections, natural light and the use of space to suit the family’s everyday needs.
features: Connection between indoor and outdoor spaces

pvc-doors-windows.title: PVC doors and windows
pvc-doors-windows.description: PVC doors and windows to complete the comfort of a home.
pvc-doors-windows.longDescription: Doors and windows are an important part of a building’s appearance and interior environment. Work in this area considers opening dimensions, the selection of suitable solutions and their coordination with the overall design.
